Nora Li: hey all, first day. on M2 mac; installed asdf via brew but my asdf shims aren’t taking precedence — python still points to /usr/bin/python3. any quick checks? :wave:
DevX Bot: welcome! paste outputs of `which python` and `echo $PATH` so we can triage.
Nora Li: which python -> /usr/bin/python3, echo $PATH -> /usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/Users/nora/.asdf/shims:/usr/local/bin
Ethan: PATH ordering — put /opt/homebrew/bin and ~/.asdf/shims before system dirs. in ~/.zshrc add: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$HOME/.asdf/shims:$PATH"` and source asdf: `. $(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh` then restart shell.
Nora Li: did that, `which python` -> /Users/nora/.asdf/shims/python but python --version is still 3.9.
Ethan: run `asdf plugin-add python` then `asdf install python 3.11.4` and `asdf global python 3.11.4` followed by `asdf reshim`. also check you don’t have NVM/pyenv lines that conflict.
Nora Li: found `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh` leftover — removed it, installed 3.11.4, reshim. node and python now correct. VS Code still picked old interpreter until I launched it from terminal (code .) so noting that.
Nora Li: final Q: where are company dotfiles and hooks?
Ethan: repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dotfiles — clone and run `./setup.sh` to symlink and install git hooks. ping me if anything breaks.
Nora Li: thanks everyone, super helpful! :tada:
